exposure: Methyl tert-butyl ether (MTBE) at 500 and 1000 mg/Kg
cohort: Pregnant NMRI mice were divided into control and test groups for exposure to MTBE.
finding: MTBE exposure significantly increased the weight and crown-rump length of fetuses, the weight and diameter of placentas, mitochondrial swelling, and ROS formation, while significantly decreasing MMP in isolated liver and brain mitochondria of fetuses.
gest_age: Exposure at 11 days of gestation, examination at 15 days of gestation
